claim: In the United States Code 2024 Edition, 31 U.S.C. 5112(b) specifies the five-cent coin alloy as 75 percent copper and 25 percent nickel, by weight.
scope: Dated codified statutory specification, not present-law currency certification or physical composition assay.
answer: The 2024 Edition statutory specification is 75 percent copper and 25 percent nickel by weight.

evidence.checked: Direct official web text states the five-cent alloy as 75 percent copper and 25 percent nickel, and applies the weight basis to alloy specifications. The tolerance provision is not interpreted as a numeric range. Credits in the dated edition do not themselves prove currentness.
